description:
- Added movie and episode downloads for supported streams.
- Downloads save directly to Downloads/Phantom Movies on your device.
- Added a download dialog with progress, pause, resume, retry, and Hide controls.
- Downloads continue while the dialog is hidden or the app is in the background.
- Downloaded videos can be played offline from the Downloads page.
- Added download progress bars to the Downloads page.
- Added a download removal dialog. Removing an item only hides it from Downloads and keeps the device file.
- Updated notifications to use the Phantom Movies notification icon.

releases.description:
- Added useful stream details beneath the existing server names in the player.
- Shows supported quality, audio languages, and subtitles when detected.
- Added live status labels for playing, paused, loading, buffering, and failed sources.
- Distinguishes untried servers, previously tried servers, and prepared backups.
- Server details refresh while the selector is open, including during automatic failover.
- Failed servers remain available to retry.
